step1_analysis.description: The circuit uses an inverter (XM2, XM4) and two NMOS pull-down transistors (XM3, XM5) to drive a diode-connected PMOS load (XM1, XM6). It generates a voltage pulse at the output whenever the input transitions across the inverter's threshold, effectively acting as an edge detector or frequency doubler.

paper_reference.title: A Pseudo-CCM/DCM SIMO Switching Converter With Freewheel Switching

VOUT_peak.description: Peak voltage of the output pulse during input transition

sky130_expected.calculation: At VIN = Vinv (~0.71V), both NMOS are in saturation. I_total = 2 * 0.5 * 2.7m * (0.71 - 0.42)^2 = 226uA. PMOS load Vsg = sqrt(226uA / 0.5m) + 0.42 = 1.09V. VOUT = 1.8 - 1.09 = 0.71V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact threshold and mobility in SKY130.

VOUT_low.description: Baseline output voltage when input is static (0 or VDD)

sky130_expected.calculation: When IN=1.8V, XM3 is ON with Vgs=1.8V. It enters linear region. Equating linear NMOS current with saturated PMOS load current gives VOUT ~ 0.2V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the strength ratio of the NMOS pull-down vs PMOS diode load.

Pulse_Width.description: Full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the output pulse

sky130_expected.calculation: With a 10ns input rise time, the input stays in the transition region (where both NMOS are weakly ON) for about 4ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the input slew rate.

Power_avg.description: Average power consumption of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Static current is ~0.6mA when output is low. 0.6mA * 1.8V = 1.08mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the static current drawn by the ON NMOS and PMOS load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the edge detector's pulse characteristics and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Edge Detector Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 OUT OUT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT IN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 IN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT OUT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* 1MHz clock with 10ns rise/fall times
VIN IN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 100n 10n 10n 390n 1u)

.control
* DC Sweep to find static transfer characteristics
dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vout_dc_peak max v(out)
meas dc vout_dc_low find v(out) at=1.8

* Transient analysis for pulse characteristics
tran 0.1n 2u
meas tran vout_peak max v(out) from=90n to=130n
meas tran vout_low min v(out) from=0 to=90n

* Measure pulse width at ~0.45V (approximate half maximum)
meas tran pulse_width trig v(out) val=0.45 rise=1 targ v(out) val=0.45 fall=1

* Measure average power
meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD)
let power_mw = -pwr_avg * 1.8 * 1000
print power_mw
quit
.endc
